entities.name: Eshki Dragonclaw
entities.description: A human warrior of Tarkir, khan of the Temur Frontier, bound to the spirit dragon Ureni.

entities.name: Ureni
entities.description: A spirit dragon called into being by Eshki.

entities.name: Alniul
entities.description: Eshki's good friend and co-leader of the Temur; a Twice Whisperer.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragonlord whose brood Eshki once served.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: Challenged Eshki for leadership of the Temur rebellion, later infected by blight.

entities.name: Unwritten Now
entities.description: The secret history of the Temur.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: The ritual during which Eshki called Ureni into being.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Eshki took charge of the Atarka forces.

events.summary: After her hunting group is attacked by one of Atarka's brood, Eshki escapes into the mountains and meets Alniul.
events.quote: When her hunting group was attacked by one of Atarka's brood and left for dead, Eshki had enough.

events.summary: Eshki takes charge of the scattered Atarka forces during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Eshki took charge of the scattered Atarka forces to fight back against the invaders.

events.summary: Surrak challenges Eshki; she defeats him, is appointed Dragonclaw, and the rebellion succeeds.
events.quote: She was appointed Dragonclaw, and the rebellion was ultimately successful.

events.summary: During the Stormnexus Ritual, Eshki calls the spirit dragon Ureni into being.
events.quote: Eshki called the spirit dragon Ureni into being

events.summary: Eshki, Alniul and Surrak end the blight by pledging all would be welcome at the Temur fires; Surrak rejoins the clan.
events.quote: They pledged that all would be welcome at the fires of the Temur, and the blight was brought to an end.

relations.quote: She is the current khan of the Temur Frontier
leads the Temur together with her good friend, the Twice Whisperer Alniul

relations.note: Called the spirit dragon into being.
relations.quote: shaping their essence with her own beliefs

relations.note: Challenged her and held a grudge.
relations.quote: although he still held a grudge against the former
